steps.text: Peanut butter (20/25 g) and yoghurt (80/100 g) beaten together. It will look split for a moment — keep going, it comes back.
1 tsp suya (2/2 g), lime, salt, then warm water a teaspoon at a time until it's just scoopable.

why: It splits, then it doesn't. Peanut butter and yoghurt seize when they first meet and it looks wrong — thirty seconds of hard beating brings it smooth, and adding the water too early stops that ever happening.
notes: Seasoning addition (rule 5): reuses the suya_spice id introduced for b-d3d (see _ingredients.B.json). 1 tsp suya (~4 g total) split by the dip-base ratio (peanut butter + yoghurt, 100:125) -> 2/2 g (both round the same). Macro impact is trivial (~10 kcal/cover) — no >30 kcal note required.
No oil, no lettuce — no D0-003 substitutions apply.
